claims.normalized_statement: theorem cyclic_point_relation {G I : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] [Fintype I] {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (P Q : G) (generates : ∀ x, x ∈ AddSubgroup.zmultiples P) (cardinality : Nat.card G = n) (B : I → G) (c : I → ZMod n) (a b : ZMod n) (relation : (∑ i, (c i).val • B i) = a.val • P + b.val • Q) : let log
claims.human_statement: For an additive commutative group G generated by P of exact nonzero cardinality n, any finite indexed group relation sum(c_i.val times B_i)=a.val times P+b.val times Q implies sum(c_i*log(B_i))-b*log(Q)=a in ZMod n, with log constructed from the cyclic isomorphism.

claims.normalized_statement: theorem prime_card_generates {G : Type*} [AddGroup G] {n : ℕ} [Fact n.Prime] (cardinality : Nat.card G = n) (P : G) (nonzero : P ≠ 0) : ∀ x, x ∈ AddSubgroup.zmultiples P
claims.human_statement: An additive group G of exact prime cardinality n is generated by every nonzero element P.

claims.normalized_statement: theorem prime_order_point_relation {G I : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] [Fintype I] {n : ℕ} [Fact n.Prime] (P Q : G) (nonzero : P ≠ 0) (cardinality : Nat.card G = n) (B : I → G) (c : I → ZMod n) (a b : ZMod n) (relation : (∑ i, (c i).val • B i) = a.val • P + b.val • Q) : let log
claims.human_statement: In an additive commutative group G of exact prime cardinality n, a nonzero P generates G; each finite indexed point relation sum(c_i.val times B_i)=a.val times P+b.val times Q implies the corresponding scalar equation sum(c_i*log(B_i))-b*log(Q)=a under the constructed cyclic coordinates.

claims.normalized_statement: theorem recovery_combination {K I J : Type*} [Field K] [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [DecidableEq I] (M : J → I → K) (z : I → K) (rhs weights : J → K) (target : I) (value : K) (rows : ∀ j, ThreeLeads.rowEval (M j) z = rhs j) (certificate : ∀ i, (∑ j, weights j * M j i) = if i = target then 1 else 0) (rightHandSide : (∑ j, weights j * rhs j) = value) : z target = value
claims.human_statement: Over a field K with finite column and row sets, if Mz=rhs, weights combine coefficient columns to the target unit row, and weights combine the right-hand sides to value, then z[target]=value.

claims.normalized_statement: theorem target_ambiguity {K I J : Type*} [Field K] [Fintype I] (M : J → I → K) (z h : I → K) (rhs : J → K) (target : I) (rows : ∀ j, ThreeLeads.rowEval (M j) z = rhs j) (kernel : ∀ j, ThreeLeads.rowEval (M j) h = 0) (changes : h target = 1) : (∀ j, ThreeLeads.rowEval (M j) (z + h) = rhs j) ∧ (z + h) target ≠ z target
claims.human_statement: Over a field K with finitely many columns and arbitrary rows, if Mz=rhs, Mh=0 and h[target]=1, then z+h also satisfies the retained equations and its target coordinate differs from z[target]. This concerns linear equations, not multiple curve logarithms.
